lines.zh: 我横着走，八条腿一起挪。
lines.en: I walk sideways, eight legs moving together.

lines.zh: 我背上粘的海藻跟着晃。
lines.en: The algae on my back sways as I go.

lines.zh: 沙底有一道我的浅沟。
lines.en: I leave a shallow groove in the sand.

lines.zh: 我爬过珊瑚碎屑，卡了一下。
lines.en: I crawl over coral rubble and snag once.

lines.zh: 红草甸的草挡住我的眼。
lines.en: The red seagrass blocks my view.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪，不着急。
lines.en: I move slowly; there is no hurry.

lines.zh: 一块小珊瑚粘在我壳上，重。
lines.en: A bit of coral stuck to my shell is heavy.

lines.zh: 我从礁石侧面绕过去。
lines.en: I go around the side of the reef rock.

lines.zh: 腿一撑，我翻过一片碎石。
lines.en: Legs braced, I climb over broken stone.

lines.zh: 我沿着沙底的纹路走。
lines.en: I follow the ripples written in the sand.

lines.zh: 两只装饰蟹，一前一后地爬。
lines.en: Two decorator crabs crawl, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 我停下来，把背上的草理好。
lines.en: I stop and tidy the weeds on my back.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我走得更稳。
lines.en: The tide is out, so my footing is better.

lines.zh: 我这一身打扮，走起来沙沙响。
lines.en: Dressed like this, I rustle with every step.

lines.zh: 我背着一整片珊瑚走路。
lines.en: I walk carrying a whole patch of coral.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里挤出去，壳响。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crevice and my shell scrapes.

lines.zh: 我沿着礁缘横着挪。
lines.en: I sidle along the reef's edge.

lines.zh: 潮水把我往岸上推了一点。
lines.en: The tide nudges me a little shoreward.

lines.zh: 我趴在沙上，等潮水过来。
lines.en: I lie on the sand and wait for the tide.

lines.zh: 一只小虾从我的腿间走过。
lines.en: A tiny shrimp walks between my legs.

lines.zh: 我把钳子举高，又放下。
lines.en: I raise a claw high, then lower it.

lines.zh: 背上这丛草，谁也看不出我。
lines.en: With this weed on my back, nobody spots me.

lines.zh: 我用钳子刮壳上的泥。
lines.en: I scrape mud off my shell with a claw.

lines.zh: 沙粒滚进壳缝里，有点痒。
lines.en: Sand rolled into my shell seam and itches.

lines.zh: 风平浪静，水底的影子也不动。
lines.en: The sea is calm; shadows on the floor stay still.

lines.zh: 我在等一只不长眼的虫子。
lines.en: I am waiting for some careless little bug.

lines.zh: 珊瑚洞里，凉气正好。
lines.en: The coral hollow has just the right coolness.

lines.zh: 我把一小片海葵挪到肩上。
lines.en: I move a bit of anemone onto my shoulder.

lines.zh: 谁经过，我都装成石头。
lines.en: Whoever passes, I play the part of stone.

lines.zh: 钳子夹着草，我慢慢嚼。
lines.en: Claw holding weed, I chew it slowly.

lines.zh: 这片沙底，安静得发闷。
lines.en: This sandy floor is quiet enough to smother.

lines.zh: 我伸了伸腿，壳里有东西响。
lines.en: I stretch a leg; something rattles inside my shell.

lines.zh: 你弯腰看我，我立刻装石头。
lines.en: You bend to look; I instantly become a rock.

lines.zh: 你踩到的影子，盖住了我的壳。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my shell completely.

lines.zh: 我从草缝里露出两只眼睛。
lines.en: I show two eyes through the seagrass.

lines.zh: 你那么高，我仰着头看。
lines.en: You are so tall; I look straight up.

lines.zh: 我往沙里缩了半个身子。
lines.en: I sink half my body into the sand.

lines.zh: 你手上有没有能粘的东西。
lines.en: I wonder if you have anything stickable in hand.

lines.zh: 我举钳子，只是吓吓你。
lines.en: I raise a claw only to scare you.

lines.zh: 你若抓我，我就掉一条腿。
lines.en: If you grab me, I will drop a leg.

lines.zh: 这片礁上的东西，都归我挑。
lines.en: Everything on this reef is mine to pick.

lines.zh: 你走了，我才敢继续爬。
lines.en: Only after you leave do I crawl on.

lines.zh: 壳上多了条细缝，进水了。
lines.en: A thin crack opened and water seeps in.

lines.zh: 腿断了一条，我还能爬。
lines.en: One leg is gone; I can still crawl.

lines.zh: 背上装饰掉了一地。
lines.en: My decorations are scattered across the floor.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的钳子张不开了。
lines.en: After that blow my claw will not open.

lines.zh: 我往沙里钻，钻得很深。
lines.en: I dig into the sand, and I dig deep.

lines.zh: 疼得我连壳都在抖。
lines.en: It hurts so much my shell is shaking.

lines.zh: 我只有三点生命，撑不久。
lines.en: I have only three points, and not for long.

lines.zh: 血混进沙里，颜色很深。
lines.en: Blood mixes into the sand, dark and spreading.

lines.zh: 我缩在石缝里，一动不动。
lines.en: I curl in a rock crack without moving.

lines.zh: 伪装没用了，我被人看见了。
lines.en: My disguise is useless; I have been seen.

lines.zh: 你丢下的碎鱼，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the fish scraps you dropped.

lines.zh: 我横着挪了两步，又停住。
lines.en: I shuffle two steps sideways and stop.

lines.zh: 这味道，比海藻强多了。
lines.en: This smells far better than algae.

lines.zh: 我把钳子伸出去，先探探路。
lines.en: I reach out a claw to test the way.

lines.zh: 同伴也来了，我们挤在一起。
lines.en: My companion arrives and we crowd in.

lines.zh: 你不动，我就敢再近一点。
lines.en: If you stay still, I dare come closer.

lines.zh: 壳上这身伪装，现在碍事。
lines.en: All this camouflage on my shell is in the way.

lines.zh: 我先夹住，再拖回洞里。
lines.en: I grab it first, then drag it home.

lines.zh: 这么大方的人，总有点怪。
lines.en: Someone this generous is always a bit strange.

lines.zh: 别人一抢，我立刻竖钳。
lines.en: Another grabs and my claws go up.

lines.zh: 你一脚踩下，我被埋进沙里。
lines.en: One step from you buried me in the sand.

lines.zh: 我的壳被撞得搬了家。
lines.en: The knock moved my shell to a new spot.

lines.zh: 背上的草全乱了，我理了半天。
lines.en: My back weeds are wrecked; I fix them for ages.

lines.zh: 水被搅浑，我只好停下。
lines.en: The water clouds and I have to stop.

lines.zh: 我只有三点生命，别这么撞。
lines.en: I have only three points of health; do not shove.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，腿乱蹬。
lines.en: I flipped over and my legs flail.

lines.zh: 钳子卡在石缝里，我拔不出。
lines.en: A claw is stuck in the rock; I cannot pull free.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我掉了半身伪装。
lines.en: That hit cost me half my disguise.

lines.zh: 我贴住沙底，不敢再动。
lines.en: I press to the sand and will not move.

lines.zh: 你走开之后，沙才慢慢沉下。
lines.en: Only after you leave does the sand settle.

lines.zh: 我要找壳上装饰最漂亮的那只。
lines.en: I want the one with the finest decorated shell.

lines.zh: 我举高双钳，横着晃两下。
lines.en: I raise both claws and sway sideways.

lines.zh: 她侧过身，我才敢靠过去。
lines.en: She turns; only then do I approach.

lines.zh: 我们先把沙子扫成一个坑。
lines.en: We sweep the sand into a little hollow.

lines.zh: 这身打扮，也是为了给她看。
lines.en: This outfit is partly for her to see.

lines.zh: 她钳子一夹，我退了半步。
lines.en: One pinch of hers and I step back.

lines.zh: 洞里很暗，正合适。
lines.en: The burrow is dark, which suits us.

lines.zh: 我在洞口守着，谁来都不让。
lines.en: I stand at the entrance; no one passes.

lines.zh: 两只蟹并排趴着，都不出声。
lines.en: Two crabs lie side by side in silence.

lines.zh: 你看着也没用，别打扰。
lines.en: Watching will not help; do not interrupt.

lines.zh: 我夹起一片红草，往背上贴。
lines.en: I pinch red weed and stick it on my back.

lines.zh: 这块海绵软，正合我意。
lines.en: This sponge is soft; just what I want.

lines.zh: 我试了三次，才把它粘稳。
lines.en: It took three tries to stick it firm.

lines.zh: 太重了，我拖着走两步就放。
lines.en: Too heavy; I drag it two paces and drop it.

lines.zh: 壳上已经没地方挂了。
lines.en: There is no space left on my shell.

lines.zh: 同伴盯着我夹的东西，想抢。
lines.en: My companion eyes what I hold, wanting it.

lines.zh: 我把小珊瑚夹到壳边试了试。
lines.en: I test a bit of coral against my shell.

lines.zh: 这东西会动，我不敢要。
lines.en: This thing moves, so I leave it.

lines.zh: 夹住就别松，我记着这规矩。
lines.en: Grip and never let go; that is my rule.

lines.zh: 走一趟回来，我身上又多了块。
lines.en: One trip later, my shell has one more piece.

lines.zh: 沙里有东西在动，我停住。
lines.en: Something moves in the sand; I freeze.

lines.zh: 是条小鱼，离我不到一臂。
lines.en: A small fish, less than an arm away.

lines.zh: 我把钳子张开，压低身子。
lines.en: I open my claws and flatten myself.

lines.zh: 它要是过来，我就夹它的鳍。
lines.en: If it comes near, I will pinch its fin.

lines.zh: 这礁上，我不算最弱的。
lines.en: On this reef, I am not the weakest.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到它的侧面。
lines.en: I edge around to its flank.

lines.zh: 它还没注意到我这堆草。
lines.en: It has not noticed this pile of weeds.

lines.zh: 谁动我背上的东西，我记着谁。
lines.en: Whoever touches my back, I will remember.

lines.zh: 我先看看，它有没有壳。
lines.en: First let me see whether it has a shell.

lines.zh: 钳子举久了，有点酸。
lines.en: Holding my claws up is making them ache.

lines.zh: 我横着绕，等它背对我。
lines.en: I circle sideways, waiting for its back.

lines.zh: 它一停，我就往前蹭一寸。
lines.en: When it stops, I creep an inch closer.

lines.zh: 沙子从我腿下流走，很慢。
lines.en: Sand trickles from under my legs, slowly.

lines.zh: 我伏到沙面，腿都收紧了。
lines.en: I flatten onto the sand, legs drawn tight.

lines.zh: 它看着别处，正是时候。
lines.en: It is looking elsewhere; now is the time.

lines.zh: 我这身伪装，它看不出来。
lines.en: It cannot pick me out in this disguise.

lines.zh: 钳子离它就差一点。
lines.en: My claw is a hairsbreadth from it.

lines.zh: 同伴在旁边等，也张着钳。
lines.en: My companion waits beside me, claws open.

lines.zh: 它要是跑了，我追不上。
lines.en: If it bolts, I will never catch it.

lines.zh: 我再等一会儿，不急。
lines.en: I will wait a little longer; no rush.

lines.zh: 我一夹，只夹到一嘴沙。
lines.en: I pinch and get only a mouthful of sand.

lines.zh: 钳子碰到它的鳞，滑开了。
lines.en: My claw hits its scales and slides off.

lines.zh: 我用整只钳子砸它一下。
lines.en: I bring the whole claw down on it.

lines.zh: 它一甩尾，我就被掀翻。
lines.en: One tail swipe flips me over.

lines.zh: 这一夹，我夹住了它的鳍。
lines.en: This pinch caught hold of its fin.

lines.zh: 我打得很凶，其实心虚。
lines.en: I hit hard, though my nerve is thin.

lines.zh: 沙扬起来，我自己都看不见。
lines.en: The sand rises and I lose sight too.

lines.zh: 同伴上来帮忙，我们夹同一个。
lines.en: My companion joins and we pinch the same spot.

lines.zh: 钳子发麻，我只好松开。
lines.en: My claw goes numb, so I let go.

lines.zh: 打完我缩回壳里，装没事。
lines.en: Done, I pull in and pretend nothing happened.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚礁的碎石里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out from the rubble of the reef.

lines.zh: 背上还没有装饰，光秃秃的。
lines.en: My back is bare; nothing decorates it yet.

lines.zh: 红草甸的水很浅，正好落脚。
lines.en: The red seagrass flat is shallow and easy footing.

lines.zh: 一出生就只有两只，各走各的。
lines.en: Only two of us were born, and we parted.

lines.zh: 我第一件事是找片海藻背着。
lines.en: First I look for a bit of seaweed to carry.

lines.zh: 壳还是软的，我爬得很小心。
lines.en: My shell is still soft; I crawl carefully.

lines.zh: 潮水刚退，沙底晒得发暖。
lines.en: The tide just left and the sand is warm.

lines.zh: 我掰下第一块珊瑚当帽子。
lines.en: I break off my first coral for a hat.

lines.zh: 这片礁很大，我得慢慢熟。
lines.en: This reef is large; I will learn it slowly.

lines.zh: 从今天起，我的壳要换十次装扮。
lines.en: From today my shell will be redecorated many times.

lines.zh: 水是凉的，可火还是烧到了我。
lines.en: The water is cold, yet the fire still reached me.

lines.zh: 我被摔在礁石上，壳响了一声。
lines.en: I was dropped on the reef and my shell rang.

lines.zh: 我明明住在水里，却喘不上气。
lines.en: I live in the water, yet I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 炸开的水把我掀了个底朝天。
lines.en: The blast flipped me onto my back.

lines.zh: 一支箭射穿了我的伪装。
lines.en: An arrow shot clean through my disguise.

lines.zh: 紫光落下来，我的腿都不听使唤。
lines.en: Purple light fell and my legs stopped obeying.

lines.zh: 沙底翻遍了，一点能吃都没有。
lines.en: I searched the whole floor and found nothing.

lines.zh: 雷打进浅水，我的壳都发烫。
lines.en: Lightning hit the shallows and my shell went hot.

lines.zh: 沙底忽然空了，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: The seabed vanished and I fell through nothing.
